Load libraries
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
```

Load Mtx data
```{r}
x = Seurat::ReadMtx("~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_human_counts_normalized_54773x41861.mtx.gz", cells = "~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv/human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv", features = "~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_gene_names_human_41861.tsv.gz", cell.column = 5, feature.column = 1, mtx.transpose = T, skip.cell = 1)
metada = read.csv("~/Downloads/Zilionis_scRNA/GSE127465_human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv/human_cell_metadata_54773x25.tsv", sep = "\t")
seurat_object <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = x)
seurat_object@meta.data = cbind(seurat_object@meta.data, metada) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Barcode)
rm(x, metada)
gc()
```

scRNAseq processing
```{r}
seurat_object <- ScaleData(seurat_object)
seurat_object <- FindVariableFeatures(object = seurat_object)
seurat_object <- RunPCA(seurat_object, features = VariableFeatures(object = seurat_object))
ElbowPlot(seurat_object) #determine dimensionality of data
seurat_object = FindNeighbors(seurat_object, dims = 1:20)
seurat_object = FindClusters(seurat_object, resolution = 1)
seurat_object <- RunUMAP(seurat_object, dims = 1:10)

pdf("Results/UMAP_MostLM22", width = 12, height = 8)
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction="umap", label = T, group.by = "Most.likely.LM22.cell.type")
dev.off()

pdf("Results/UMAP_Major", width = 12, height = 8)
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction="umap", label = T, group.by = "Major.cell.type")
dev.off()

pdf("Results/UMAP_Minor", width = 20, height = 8)
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction="umap", label = T, group.by = "Minor.subset")
dev.off()
```

Regroup cells in more general clusters
```{r}
seurat_object@meta.data$general = as.character(seurat_object@meta.data$Most.likely.LM22.cell.type)

macrophages = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("Macrophages M0", "Macrophages M1", "Macrophages M2"))]
Bcells = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("B cells memory", "B cells naive"))]
dendritic_cells = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("Dendritic cells activated", "Dendritic cells resting"))]
mast = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("Mast cells activated", "Mast cells resting"))]
nk = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("NK cells activated", "NK cells resting"))]
tcell = rownames(seurat_object@meta.data)[which(seurat_object@meta.data$general %in% c("T cells CD4 memory activated", "T cells CD4 memory resting", "T cells CD4 naive",
                                                                                            "T cells follicular helper", "T cells regulatory (Tregs)", "T cells CD8"))]
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% macrophages)] = "Macrophages"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% Bcells)] = "B cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% dendritic_cells)] = "Dendritic cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% mast)] = "Mast cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% nk)] = "NK cells"
seurat_object@meta.data$general[which(rownames(seurat_object@meta.data) %in% tcell)] = "T cells"

seurat_object@meta.data$general = as.factor(seurat_object@meta.data$general)
Idents(seurat_object) = seurat_object@meta.data$general
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction="umap", label = T, pt.size = 0.5)
```

Marker expression
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

markers1 = c("XCR1", "CLEC9A", "BATF3", "IRF8")
markers2 = c("FCER1A", "CD1C", "IRF4")
markers3 = c("CLEC4C")
markers4 = c("FSCN1", "CCR7", "LY75", "CCL22", "CD40", "BIRC3", "NFKB2", "IL12B")

markers = markers4

# Extract marker expression
expr_matrix <- FetchData(dendritic, vars = markers)

# Get cluster identities
clusters <- Idents(dendritic)

# Convert to long format and add cluster info
expr_long <- expr_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Cluster = clusters) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(markers), names_to = "Marker", values_to = "Expression")

# Count the number of cells with nonzero expression per marker per cluster
expr_summary <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Marker) %>%
  summarise(Count = mean(Expression), .groups = "drop")

# Plot barplot
for(i in unique(expr_summary$Marker)){
  print(ggplot(expr_summary %>%
           filter(Marker == i), aes(x = Cluster, y = Count, fill = Marker)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste0("Marker expression ", i, " across clusters"),
         x = paste0("Marker ", i),
         y = "Mean expression across clusters") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)))
}

#Cluster2 ---> tDC1
#Cluster0 ---> tDC2
#Cluster3 ---> tDC3 (Activated DC) 
#Cluster1 ---> tpDC
```

TF activity on Dendritic cluster
```{r}
source("src/environment_set.R")
clust1 = as.matrix(dendritic@assays$RNA@data)[,which(dendritic@meta.data$DCclusters == "tpDC")]

clust3 = as.matrix(dendritic@assays$RNA@data)[,which(dendritic@meta.data$DCclusters == "tDC2")]

tf1 = compute.TFs.activity(clust1)
tf2 = compute.TFs.activity(clust2)

dendritic_tf = rbind(tf1, tf2, tf3, tf4)
```

Pathways activity
```{r}
net <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = 'human', top = 500)
# Extract the normalized log-transformed counts
mat <- as.matrix(dendritic@assays$RNA@data)

# Run mlm
acts <- decoupleR::run_mlm(mat = mat, 
                           net = net, 
                           .source = 'source', 
                           .target = 'target',
                           .mor = 'weight', 
                           minsize = 5)

# Extract mlm and store it in pathwaysmlm in data
dendritic[['pathwaysmlm']] <- acts %>%
                         tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = 'source', 
                                            names_from = 'condition',
                                            values_from = 'score') %>%
                         tibble::column_to_rownames(var = 'source') %>%
                         Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

# Change assay
Seurat::DefaultAssay(object = dendritic) <- "pathwaysmlm"

# Scale the data
dendritic <- Seurat::ScaleData(dendritic)
dendritic@assays$pathwaysmlm@data <- dendritic@assays$pathwaysmlm@scale.data
```

Exploration
```{r}
# Extract activities from object as a long dataframe
df <- t(as.matrix(dendritic@assays$pathwaysmlm@data)) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cluster = Seurat::Idents(dendritic)) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -cluster, 
                          names_to = "source", 
                          values_to = "score") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(cluster, source) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(score))

# Transform to wide matrix
top_acts_mat <- df %>%
                tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = 'cluster', 
                                   names_from = 'source',
                                   values_from = 'mean') %>%
                tibble::column_to_rownames(var = 'cluster') %>%
                as.matrix()

# Color scale
colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
colors.use <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colors = colors)(100)

my_breaks <- c(seq(-1.25, 0, length.out = ceiling(100 / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 1.25, length.out = floor(100 / 2)))

# Plot
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = top_acts_mat,
                   color = colors.use,
                   border_color = "white",
                   breaks = my_breaks,
                   cellwidth = 20,
                   cellheight = 20,
                   treeheight_row = 20,
                   treeheight_col = 20) 
```

Metacells: Setup object
```{r}
library(hdWGCNA)

data <- SetupForWGCNA(
  seurat_object,
  gene_select = "fraction", # the gene selection approach
  fraction = 0.05, # fraction of cells that a gene needs to be expressed in order to be included
  wgcna_name = "MetaCells" # the name of the hdWGCNA experiment
)

rm(seurat_object)
gc()
```

Parallelize
```{r}
library(future)
Idents(data) = data@meta.data$new_annotation
subset_data = list()
contador = 1
cells_labels = unique(data@meta.data$new_annotation)
cells = cells_labels[!cells_labels %in% c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3")]
for (cell_type in cells) {
  for (patient in unique(data@meta.data$Patient)) {
    x = subset(x = data, subset = Patient == patient, idents = cell_type, return.null = T)
    if(is.null(x) == F){
      subset_data[[contador]] <- x
      contador = contador + 1
    }
  }
}

# Function to process each group
process_group <- function(data) {
  
  if (ncol(data) < 50) {
    message("Skipping group: Less than 50 cells in this subset")
    return(NULL) # Return NULL for groups with insufficient cells
  }
  
  #Create Metacells by Groups celltype_patient
  seurat_obj = MetacellsByGroups(seurat_obj = data,
                    min_cells = 50,
                    group.by = c("new_annotation", "Patient"),
                    reduction = 'pca',
                    k = 15,
                    max_shared = 15,
                    ident.group = 'new_annotation')
  
  meta = GetMetacellObject(seurat_obj)
  list(counts = as.matrix(meta@assays[["RNA"]]@counts), metadata = meta@meta.data)
  
}

# Set up parallelization using the future package
plan(multicore, workers = 4) # Adjust the number of workers based on your system
# Run the function in parallel
results <- future.apply::future_lapply(subset_data, process_group)
results <- results[!sapply(results, is.null)]
reference = data@meta.data[,c("general", "new_annotation")]

rm(data, subset_data)
gc()

# Combine results into a single Seurat object (if needed)
counts_sc = do.call(cbind, lapply(results, '[[', 1))
metadata = do.call(rbind, lapply(results, '[[', 2))

rm(results)
gc()
```

Pseudobulk
```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(glmGamPoi)
#Convert to SingleCell 
seurat_object@meta.data$Patient = as.factor(seurat_object@meta.data$Patient)
seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation = as.factor(seurat_object@meta.data$new_annotation)
sce = as.SingleCellExperiment(seurat_object)
##Aggregating counts
aggr_counts <- glmGamPoi::pseudobulk(sce, group_by = vars(Patient), aggregation_functions = list(counts = "rowMeans2", .default = "rowMeans2")) 
pseudo_counts = data.frame(aggr_counts@assays@data$counts) 
pseudo_counts = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(pseudo_counts, log=F) %>%
  data.frame()

#Save pseudobulk matrix 
write.table(pseudo_counts, paste0("Pseudobulk_Zilionis.txt"), quote = F, sep = "\t", row.names = F)
#pseudo_counts = read.delim("Pseudobulk_Zilionis.txt", row.names = 1)
```

Cell proportions
```{r}
total = list()
patients = levels(seurat_object@meta.data$Patient)

for (i in 1:length(patients)) {
  total[[i]] = seurat_object@meta.data %>%
    filter(Patient %in% patients[i])
}
names(total) = patients

cell_types = levels(seurat_object)
cells = list()
counts = c()
for (i in 1:length(total)) {
  for (j in 1:length(cell_types)) {
    data = total[[i]] %>%
      filter(new_annotation %in% cell_types[j])
    counts = c(counts, nrow(data))
  }
  counts = as.vector(counts)
  names(counts) = cell_types
  cells[[i]] = counts
  counts = c()
}
names(cells) = patients

proportions = list()
ratio = c()
for (i in 1:length(cells)) {
  for (j in cell_types) {
    ratio = c(ratio, round(cells[[i]][[j]]/nrow(total[[i]]), 6))
  }
  ratio = as.vector(ratio)
  names(ratio) = cell_types
  proportions[[i]] = ratio
  ratio = c()
}
names(proportions) = patients

## Groundtruth matrix
patients <- levels(colData(sce)$Patient)
cells <- levels(colData(sce)$new_annotation)

##Prepare data from single cell (Ground truth)
cells_groundtruth = as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = length(proportions), ncol = length(cells)))
rownames(cells_groundtruth) = patients
colnames(cells_groundtruth) = cells
for (i in 1:nrow(cells_groundtruth)) {
  cells_groundtruth[i,] = unname(proportions[[i]])
}
```

Rename groundtruth
```{r}
####################################################### Use in case we have all the subtypes
cells_groundtruth <- cells_groundtruth %>%
  dplyr::rename("B.memory" = "B cells memory",
                "B.naive" = "B cells naive",
                "CD8.cells" = "T cells CD8",
                "CD4.naive" = "T cells CD4 naive",
                "CD4.memory.activated" = "T cells CD4 memory activated",
                "CD4.memory.resting" = "T cells CD4 memory resting",
                "Dendritic.activated" = "Dendritic cells activated",
                "Dendritic.resting" = "Dendritic cells resting",
                "Mast.activated" = "Mast cells activated",
                "Mast.resting" = "Mast cells resting",
                "Macrophages.M0" = "Macrophages M0",
                "Macrophages.M1" = "Macrophages M1",
                "Macrophages.M2" = "Macrophages M2",
                "Plasma" = "Plasma cells",
                "T.cells.helper" = "T cells follicular helper",
                "T.cells.regulatory" = "T cells regulatory (Tregs)",
                "NK.activated" = "NK cells activated",
                "NK.resting" = "NK cells resting") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(B.cells = rowSums(across(c(B.memory, B.naive))),
                CD4.cells = rowSums(across(c(CD4.naive, CD4.memory.activated, CD4.memory.resting))),
                Dendritic.cells = rowSums(across(c(Dendritic.activated, Dendritic.resting))),
                Macrophages.cells = rowSums(across(c(Macrophages.M0, Macrophages.M1, Macrophages.M2))),
                Mast.cells = rowSums(across(c(Mast.activated, Mast.resting))),
                NK.cells = rowSums(across(c(NK.activated, NK.resting)))
  )
```
